# lumos_apps (Data Source)

Apps DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_apps" "my_apps" {
  connection_source = "API"
  disconnected      = false
  expand = [
    "..."
  ]
  in_app_store = true
  page_size    = 100
  page_token   = "...my_page_token..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `connection_source` (String) Filter to integrations connected via this source (`API` or `UI`). must be one of ["API", "UI"]
- `disconnected` (Boolean) Filter on whether the app has been disconnected. `false` excludes disconnected apps, `true` returns only disconnected apps whose record Lumos still holds, and omitting it lists every app. Pair `false` with `connection_source=API` to reconcile the integrations you manage from automation such as Terraform.
- `expand` (List of String) Fields to expand. Supported fields: admins, approval_workflow, default_provisioning_workflow, default_deprovisioning_workflow, custom_attributes, appstore_settings.
- `in_app_store` (Boolean) Filter by AppStore membership. `true` returns only apps in the AppStore; `false` returns only apps not in the AppStore; omit for all apps.
- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 250 are clamped to 250 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) Apps returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))
- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `admins` (Attributes List) Users and groups that administer this app. Only present when expand=admins is requested. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--admins))
- `app_class_id` (String) The catalog identifier of the underlying app (e.g. "github.com"). Custom apps return "custom".
- `approval_workflow` (Attributes) The approval workflow for this app. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=approval_workflow for the full workflow object. Omitted entirely if the caller lacks read access to approval workflow templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--approval_workflow))
- `appstore_settings` (Attributes) App Store membership and settings. Present when the caller has read access to App Store items. Returns {in_app_store} by default; expand with expand=appstore_settings for the full settings object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings))
- `category` (String) The category this app belongs to.
- `custom_attributes` (Attributes Map) Custom attributes configured on this app. Only present when expand=custom_attributes is requested. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--custom_attributes))
- `default_deprovisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The default deprovisioning workflow for this app. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=default_deprovisioning_workflow for the full workflow object. Omitted entirely if the caller lacks read access to App Store item workflows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--default_deprovisioning_workflow))
- `default_provisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The default provisioning workflow for this app. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=default_provisioning_workflow for the full workflow object. Omitted entirely if the caller lacks read access to App Store item workflows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--default_provisioning_workflow))
- `description` (String) A description of the app.
- `disconnected` (Boolean) Whether this app has been disconnected (its stored credentials removed via `DELETE /v1/apps/{app_uuid}`). A disconnected app is excluded from `GET /v1/apps?disconnected=false`; reconnect it with `PUT /v1/apps/{app_uuid}`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the app.
- `instance_id` (String) The app-instance identifier distinguishing multiple instances of the same app.
- `label` (String) The display name of the app.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the app logo image.
- `post_approval_message` (String) Custom message shown to the requester after their access request is approved.
- `status` (String) The lifecycle status of this app. One of DISCOVERED, IN_REVIEW, NEEDS_REVIEW, APPROVED, BLOCKLISTED, DEPRECATED.
- `sync_status` (String) The state of this app's most recent sync: `SYNCING` while one is running, `SUCCESS` or `FAILED` once it finished. Poll this after `POST /apps/{app_id}/sync` to follow that sync. Omitted when no sync result is recorded — the app has never synced, or was disconnected.
- `website_url` (String) URL of the app's official website.

<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings.app_store_settings_response`

Read-Only:

- `allow_multiple_permission_selection` (Boolean) When true, requesters may select more than one permission in a single request.
- `allow_permission_selection` (Boolean) When true, requesters may select which permission to request. When false, the default permission is used automatically and only approvers can change it.
- `allowed_requester_group_uuids` (List of String) UUIDs of the groups whose members may request this app. Null means the app is requestable by everyone in the tenant.
- `catalog_visibility` (String) Visibility of the app within the catalog. "visible" — shown in browse and search; "search_only" — returned only by search, not in browse; "hidden" — enrolled but not visible to requesters.
- `custom_intake_fields` (Attributes List) Custom form questions shown to requesters before they submit an access request. Null means no custom fields are configured. Read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--custom_intake_fields))
- `default_entitlement` (Attributes) The entitlement pre-selected by default when a user opens the request form. Null means no default is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--default_entitlement))
- `in_app_store` (Boolean) Whether this app is listed in the App Store catalog.
- `redirect_url` (String) If set, requesting this app redirects the user to this URL instead of going through the normal access-request flow. Null means no redirect is configured. Max 2048 characters.
- `request_instructions` (String) Custom instructions shown to a requester when they open the access-request form. Null means no custom instructions are set.
- `request_validation_webhook_uuid` (String) UUID of the inline webhook called to validate access requests before approval. Null means no validation webhook is configured.
- `time_based_access` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--time_based_access))

<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--custom_intake_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings.app_store_settings_response.custom_intake_fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Additional guidance shown alongside the prompt.
- `dropdown_options` (List of String) Selectable options for this field. Present only when field_type is "dropdown".
- `field_type` (String)
- `is_required` (Boolean) Whether the requester must answer this field to submit a request.
- `prompt` (String) The question shown to the requester.


<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--default_entitlement"></a>

<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--time_based_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings.app_store_settings_response.time_based_access`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Label of the option pre-selected when a user opens the request form. Null means no option is pre-selected.
- `options` (Attributes List) Time-based access options available for this app. Null means the app uses the domain-level defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--time_based_access--options))

<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--app_store_settings_response--time_based_access--options"></a>

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Display label for this time-based access option.
- `value_seconds` (Number) Duration in seconds. Null indicates a permanent (unlimited) access option.
